issues.description: Field visibility mismatch for Book.title: The problem statement (and the client usage) treats Book.title as a readable property (problem statement requires a Book with fields title and author; Client.main prints book.title). In the solution, the Book struct declares the title property as 'private let title: String' (Bookstore.swift), which prevents access from Client.main (Client.swift) and will cause a compilation error. This inconsistency between the declared visibility in the solution and the intended/public usage in the problem statement/client blocks students from running the provided example.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the title property accessible to the client by removing the 'private' modifier so it uses the module-default (internal) visibility, e.g. change 'private let title: String' to 'let title: String'. Alternatively, provide an explicit public/internal accessor (e.g. a read-only computed property) if a different encapsulation is required. This ensures Client.main can read book.title without compilation errors while preserving immutability.
